'''Prox''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] who [[Assassination attempt on Obi-Wan Kenobi|attempted]] to assassinate [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], as a means of gaining admission to the [[Bounty Hunters' Guild/Legends|Bounty Hunters' Guild]].
